description: This file implements the GetAppInfo class, which handles HTTP requests to retrieve application information based on a provided app name. It validates request parameters, constructs HTTP responses, and interacts with a TestService to obtain app info.

classes.name: GetAppInfo
classes.description: A class responsible for handling the 'GetAppInfo' command, processing HTTP requests, and returning application info.

methods.name: GetAppInfo::GetAppInfo
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the GetAppInfo object with a reference to the service and the HTTP request.

methods.name: GetAppInfo::run
methods.description: Executes the command: validates request parameters, retrieves app info from the service, and sends the HTTP response.
